title: Is ChatGPT better than Human Annotators? Potential and Limitations of ChatGPT in Explaining Implicit Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting ChatGPT to classify tweets from the LatentHatred dataset as implicitly hateful or not, generating natural language explanations (NLEs) for its decisions, and using human annotators (via Amazon Mechanical Turk) to evaluate the model's classification accuracy and the informativeness and clarity of its generated explanations compared to human-written ones.
